item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 03:08 PM 02 September 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sarangani(Kiamba, Maasim), #SouthCotabato(T'Boli, Polomolok, Tupi), #DavaoOriental(Lupon, Caraga, Manay, Banaybanay), #DavaoDeOro(Maragusan, Pantukan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sirawai, Sibuco, Labason, Liloy), #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan), #ZamboangaCity, #ZamboangaDelSur(PagadianCity, Labangan, Tukuran, Tigbao and Dumalinao) within the next 1-2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
